examples.text: Tengo un impulso de comprar algo.
examples.en: I have an urge to buy something.
He got off to a flying start.

examples.text: No pude resistir el impulso de aplaudir.
examples.en: I couldn't resist the urge to applaud.

examples.text: Tom sintió el impulso de salir corriendo.
examples.en: Tom felt the urge to run away.

examples.text: Era difícil resistir el impulso de retorcerle el cuello a Tom.
examples.en: It was hard to resist the impulse to wring Tom's neck.
